user.title: Hoymiles Official
user.description: Discovered {count} device(s). Pick one from the list or type the device id manually. The device id has the form client_prefix-SN.

day_plan.title: Day plan
day_plan.description: Choose which day plan (day1..day8) to edit and how many time segments it has (max 12).

day_segment.title: Segment {index} of {total} ({day})
day_segment.description: mode 1=force charge, 2=PV charge, 4=discharge. ts/te are 15-minute slots (0-96), sh/sl are SOC in %, pc/pd are power limits in W.

week_plan.title: Week plan
week_plan.description: Map each weekday to one of the day plans. Choose 'none' to run self-consumption for that day.

get_plan.title: Get current plan
get_plan.description: Query the plan currently configured for one weekday. The result is shown in the status sensor and a notification.

set_mode.title: Set EMS mode
set_mode.description: general = device self-consumption, mqtt_ctrl = MQTT power control, tou_plan = time-of-use plan.

abort.empty_week_plan: No weekday was mapped to a day plan, nothing was sent
abort.get_plan_failed: The device did not answer the plan query

set_tou_day_plan.name: Set TOU day plan
set_tou_day_plan.description: Publish one TOU day plan (day1..day8) to the device.

set_tou_week_plan.name: Set TOU week plan
set_tou_week_plan.description: Publish the weekday to day-plan mapping.

get_tou_plan.name: Get TOU plan
get_tou_plan.description: Query the plan configured for one weekday.

set_ems_mode.name: Set EMS mode
set_ems_mode.description: Switch the EMS mode (general / mqtt_ctrl / tou_plan).

reboot.name: Reboot device
reboot.description: Send the RESTART command to the device.

set_phase_output_power.name: Set multi phase output power
set_phase_output_power.description: Set the output power limit of all three phases at once.
